scope: Nationwide Uzbekistan, all 14 first-level regions including the Republic of Karakalpakstan, plus upstream transboundary context (Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Afghanistan) and basin neighbours (Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan) where a source provides it.
kindPolicy: Every series and record declares its kind. Reported country statistics and modeled reanalysis are never re-labelled as observed, and national statistics are never downscaled to field-level observations for the irrigation engine.

datasets.title: CAWater-Info (SIC ICWC) reservoir inventory, Uzbekistan
datasets.license: CAWater-Info knowledge base; attribution required, no explicit open license stated
datasets.limits: Design capacities and dam design data only; no coordinates published; no measured storage.

datasets.title: ICWC Water Yearbook 2025, Section 2: Water management situation in the Aral Sea basin
datasets.records: 7 reported basin series (Amu/Syr runoff, Kerki flow, Tuyamuyun inflow/releases, Uzbekistan Amu Darya withdrawal limit/actual, Syr reservoir storage)
datasets.limits: Basin/country aggregates compiled by ICWC from basin water organisations; transcribed values, not gauging-station time series.

datasets.title: OpenStreetMap water features, Uzbekistan (via Overpass API)
datasets.records: 5,945 features: named river/canal/drain/stream ways with simplified geometry, named water bodies, dams, pumping stations, water works; plus 14 first-level region relations with centres, Nominatim bounding boxes and simplified boundary polygons (stitched from OSM outer ways)
datasets.limits: Community mapping, not surveyed cadastre. Waterway geometry simplified to ~40 points, boundaries to ~300 points per ring. Region assignment is point-in-polygon of a centre/midpoint against simplified boundaries (5,842 of 5,945 assigned); line features are assigned by midpoint only. No hydraulic connectivity is inferred from proximity or shared names.

datasets.title: SIAT (Statistics Agency of Uzbekistan) indicator 3.01.02.0002: total water withdrawal for irrigation
datasets.publisher: Statistics Agency of Uzbekistan; preparer: Ministry of Water Resources
datasets.limits: National total only in the published table; no regional breakdown stored.

datasets.title: FAO AQUASTAT survey, Irrigation in Central Asia in Figures (2012)
datasets.records: National total dam capacity aggregate 22.2 km3 (2012)
datasets.limits: National design-capacity aggregate. The interactive AQUASTAT database at fao.org/aquastat did not expose a bulk per-variable API during this build, so no per-reservoir AQUASTAT values are stored.

datasets.title: World Bank Open Data API: water and irrigation indicators
datasets.records: 24 country-indicator series for Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Afghanistan, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan
datasets.limits: Country statistics (some source-modelled by the Bank's providers). Never field-level observations.

datasets.title: Open-Meteo Archive API (ERA5 reanalysis), region-centre monthly climate
datasets.publisher: Open-Meteo; ERA5 by Copernicus Climate Change Service / ECMWF
datasets.records: 14 series (one per first-level region), monthly precipitation sum, FAO-56 ET0 sum and mean temperature, Jan 2015 - Dec 2024, aggregated by ARIQ script from daily reanalysis at each region's administrative centre point
datasets.limits: Reanalysis grid values at a single point per region. Not rain-gauge/station observations and not field weather.

datasets.title: HydroSHEDS: HydroRIVERS / HydroBASINS
datasets.license: HydroSHEDS free-use license with attribution; commercial restrictions may apply - check hydrosheds.org license before redistribution
datasets.limits: Consulted (Feature 2). Basin/reach geometry ships as large shapefile archives; this repository has no shapefile toolchain (no geopandas/pyshp) and avoids large Git binaries, so no HydroBASINS polygons or HydroRIVERS discharge values are stored. Modeled discharge fields exist in the schema as null, never estimated.

datasets.title: FAO WaPOR remote-sensing water productivity
datasets.limits: WaPOR data are served through the WaPOR portal/API which requires portal access workflows; no open bulk download was obtained during this build. No evapotranspiration or biomass values are stored or substituted.

datasets.title: JRC Global Surface Water (Earth Engine catalog JRC/GSW1_4)
datasets.publisher: European Commission Joint Research Centre / Google Earth Engine
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (data), Earth Engine terms for platform access
datasets.limits: Access requires a Google Earth Engine account and cloud project; no direct bulk file download is offered. No satellite surface-water occurrence values are stored. OSM water bodies and CAWater inventories are used instead, with their own limits.

datasets.title: Uzbekistan hydrometeorology: Uzhydromet (gov.uz/hydromet) and water-quality monitoring portal
datasets.publisher: Agency of Hydrometeorological Service, Republic of Uzbekistan
datasets.license: Not stated on portal; no reuse assumed beyond citation
datasets.limits: Both portals were reachable, but no public machine-readable API or bulk download for hydrological/water-quality observations was found during this build (server-rendered pages). No station observations, water-quality, groundwater, or salinity values are stored; obtaining them likely requires Uzhydromet data services/agreement.

datasets.title: Global Runoff Data Centre (GRDC) river discharge
datasets.license: GRDC data policy; registration and station-owner consent required for many stations
datasets.limits: Discharge data require registration and are restricted for many Central Asian stations. No gauged discharge series are stored; river discharge fields remain null.
